GOAL: ready-to-integrate Docker recipes for **Unturned**, **The Forest**, and **Sons of the Forest** as Dockerized game servers on Nxeon. Docker pattern (one-line setupScript):
- `curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && docker run -d --name valheim -p 2456-2458:2456-2458/udp -v /opt/valheim/config:/config -e SERVER_NAME='Nxeon' --restart unless-stopped lloesche/valheim-server`

Find the BEST-MAINTAINED working Docker image per game (verify Docker Hub/GitHub 2026):
- Unturned (SteamCMD 1110390, F2P/anonymous — good free-trial funnel).
- The Forest (SteamCMD server 556450 — note it's a Windows server run via Wine/Proton in the image).
- Sons of the Forest (SteamCMD 2465200 — Windows server via Wine/Proton; capped at 8 players).

Produce, per game:
1. **Docker image** + why + verified URL.
2. **setupScript** — exact `curl … | sh && docker run -d --name <unturned|theforest|sonsoftheforest> … <image>` with correct ports (Unturned 27015-27017/udp; The Forest 27015-27016/udp + 8766/udp; Sons of the Forest 8766/udp, 27016/udp, 9700/udp), volume `-v /opt/<name>:<container path>`, sane env (server name, password placeholder, max players).
3. **Ports to forward**.
4. **game-control**: container name, on-host config file path (Unturned: Config.json/Commands.dat; The Forest: config; Sons of the Forest: dedicatedserver.cfg), restart = docker restart.
5. **game-config FamilySchema** — EXACT shape: `{ family, label, defaultVariant, variants:[{id,label,description}], fields:[{ key, label, group, type:"int"|"bool"|"enum"|"string", default, options?:[{value,label}], min?, max?, phase:"deploy"|"live", help? }] }`. Unturned variants: maps + PvP/PvE. Forest/SotF variants: game mode (Normal/Hard/Peaceful/Creative). ~4-5 real fields each.
6. **GamePlan tiers**: `[{ name, ramMB, cpuCores, diskGB, slots, priceCents, featured? }]`. Unturned LIGHT (2-4GB cheap); Forest/SotF 4-8GB, capped ~8 players.
7. **GAME_META**: `{ name, tag }`.

Use families: unturned, theforest, sonsoftheforest. Verify images real. Write it all as your final message.

Research complete. Below are three ready-to-integrate Nxeon game-server recipes, each verified against live Docker Hub / GitHub sources (checked Aug 2026). Note on the setup pattern: The Forest and Sons of the Forest are Windows-only servers run via Wine inside the jammsen images, and both cap at 8 players by the game engine. Server name/password/max-players for the two Forest games are set in the on-disk config file (not env vars), so the setupScript seeds them on first boot and game-config edits the file + `docker restart`.

---

## 1) UNTURNED — family `unturned`

**Docker image:** `fragsoc/unturned` (built from GitHub `FragSoc/unturned-docker`).
Why: it is the best standalone, non-panel Linux image. It runs the official 64-bit Linux dedicated server via SteamCMD anonymous app **1110390** (F2P — no Steam login, ideal free-trial funnel), exposes a single `/config` volume, and runs headless with `--restart`. The popular `hcgcloud/pterodactyl-unturned` was rejected — it is a Pterodactyl-egg image (needs the panel) and last updated ~5 years ago. Verified URLs: https://github.com/FragSoc/unturned-docker and image `fragsoc/unturned` on Docker Hub.

**setupScript:**
```
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && docker run -d --name unturned -p 27015-27017:27015-27017/udp -p 27015-27017:27015-27017/tcp -v /opt/unturned:/config -e SERVER_ID=nxeon -e INTERNET_SERVER=true --restart unless-stopped fragsoc/unturned
```
(Server name / password / max players / map / PvP-PvE are written to the two config files under the mounted volume — see game-control.)

**Ports to forward:** `27015/udp`, `27016/udp`, `27017/udp` (Steam query + game + master list). TCP mirrors optional but harmless.

**game-control:**
- container name: `unturned`
- on-host config: `/opt/unturned/Servers/nxeon/Server/Commands.dat` (map, name, password, maxplayers, PvP/PvE) and `/opt/unturned/Servers/nxeon/Server/Config.json` (gameplay tuning). `nxeon` = the `SERVER_ID`.
- restart: `docker restart unturned`

**game-config FamilySchema:**
```json

  "label": "Unturned",

  "variants": [

## 2) THE FOREST — family `theforest`

**Docker image:** `jammsen/the-forest-dedicated-server:latest` (GitHub `jammsen/docker-the-forest-dedicated-server`).
Why: the clearly dominant, actively maintained project (major Jan-2025 refactor: dropped root, cleaner process handling, published to Docker Hub). It runs the official **Windows** dedicated server (SteamCMD app **556450**) under Wine, headless. Verified URLs: https://github.com/jammsen/docker-the-forest-dedicated-server and https://hub.docker.com/r/jammsen/the-forest-dedicated-server.

```
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh && docker run -d --name theforest -p 27015-27016:27015-27016/udp -p 8766:8766/udp -v /opt/theforest:/theforest -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e ALWAYS_UPDATE_ON_START=true -e FILTER_SHADER_AND_MESH_AND_WINE_DEBUG=true --restart unless-stopped jammsen/the-forest-dedicated-server:latest

**Ports to forward:** `27015/udp` (game), `27016/udp` (query), `8766/udp` (Steam). (`SERVER_STEAM_ACCOUNT_TOKEN` env is optional; needed only for persistent Steam-side server identity.)

- on-host config: `/opt/theforest/config/config.cfg`
- restart: `docker restart theforest`

**GamePlan tiers** (Wine + Windows server → heavier; hard 8-slot cap):

**GAME_META:** `{ "name": "The Forest", "tag": "theforest" }`

## 3) SONS OF THE FOREST — family `sonsoftheforest`

**Docker image:** `jammsen/sons-of-the-forest-dedicated-server:latest` (GitHub `jammsen/docker-sons-of-the-forest-dedicated-server`).
Why: same maintainer/toolchain as The Forest image — actively maintained, Docker Hub published, well-documented wiki. Runs the official **Windows** dedicated server (SteamCMD app **2465200**) under Wine headless. Verified URLs: https://github.com/jammsen/docker-sons-of-the-forest-dedicated-server and https://hub.docker.com/r/jammsen/sons-of-the-forest-dedicated-server. (RouHim/`rouhim/sons-of-the-forest-server` is a solid alternative but the jammsen pair gives Nxeon one consistent config pattern across both Forest titles.)

### Integration notes / caveats
- **Config-file vs env-var split:** only Unturned's `SERVER_ID`/`INTERNET_SERVER` are true env knobs. For both Forest games, server name/password/max-players/mode live in the on-disk config file the game-config layer must template on first deploy, then `docker restart`. The jammsen images crash-loop on default passwords by design — the deploy step must inject one.
- **First-boot delay:** all three download the server via SteamCMD on first start (Forest images additionally boot Wine), so expect a slow first `docker run`; readiness checks should poll, not assume instant.
- **8-player hard cap** is a game-engine limit on both Forest titles — reflected in `max:8` and the tier `slots`. Don't sell higher.
- **Ports:** every game uses UDP for its core traffic; Unturned's TCP mirrors are optional. Match these exactly in Nxeon's port-forward/firewall allocator.
- All four images referenced are confirmed real and reachable: `fragsoc/unturned`, `jammsen/the-forest-dedicated-server`, `jammsen/sons-of-the-forest-dedicated-server` (Docker Hub), plus their GitHub repos above.
